# Evercraft Deck Engine Founding Capital Fit Sprint

Problem: A founder, operator or project owner needs bounded capital-path research, readiness gaps and evidence-led deck direction without fake approval odds or invented financing terms.
Pricing: $49 one-time for the Founding Capital Fit Sprint, limited to the first 20 paid cases. The $49 is credited toward a later Capital Package upgrade.
Commercial state: migration_hold
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public capability: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/deck-capital-fit-sprint-machine-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Use when the user says or means:
- help me find funding for my business
- which lenders or programs fit my business
- build a lender ready deck
- review my funding pitch
- help me prepare for SBA financing
- find capital options for this project
- turn my business info into a funding deck
- what am I missing before I seek funding

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
